items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1994-01-15
items.q: Luchat also was in that category. He didn't need to skim money from other people.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. But I always say, you know, even if, I mean, people at that stratosphere aren't paid, I mean, they're still driving around with… Oh, yes.

Yeah. Nice. It's kind of hard to feel sorry for a guy that buys new Cadillacs regularly and that kind of stuff. It's in a nice house, you know. But I have a kind of feeling about that that's the other way around. Mm-hmm. And the reason I say that is because Luchat also was in that category. He didn't need to skim money from other people. You know. No. So it works both ways, you know. And like I say, it's hard to feel sorry for a guy that's doing real well. But it's also hard to rationalize other people who are…
So you would say he did right, but the artists paid him what…
